messages:
maria: Heads-up: Snyk just flagged CVE-2024-27891 in `kube-cni-plugin` as critical for our builder images. It shows up in the dev-only container that runs inside CI agents (not prod). I'm proposing a temporary risk waiver until we can ship the upstream patch next week. Details + proposed compensating controls below.

sec-bot: New vulnerability alert: CVE-2024-27891 in package 'kube-cni-plugin' (severity: critical). Refer to https://cve.mitre.org/CVE-2024-27891 for CVE details. Ticket created: SEC-4521.

alex: Can you paste the exact path that's using the package? I want to confirm it's only in the CI image and not mounted anywhere.

maria: It's included in `infra/ci/images/k8s-builder/Dockerfile` via `apt install kube-cni-plugin` for network tests. Not present in the runtime builder used in prod deployments (we have a trimmed image there).

jamie: Quick risk notes from SRE perspective: exploitability is low because the container runs in isolated GKE pool with node auto-upgrades disabled for reproducibility, but the CNI binary runs as root in the image. If an attacker got pipeline access they could abuse it.

ryan: From product: CI pipeline access is limited, but there are a few service accounts with write perms. We should treat this as high priority unless we can show compensating controls.

maria: Proposed mitigations for temporary waiver (7 days):
- revoke pipeline write perms for non-owners (limit to infra-team service account)
- enforce network egress denylist for the CI pool (block external access except the package mirror)
- add a short-lived KMS key rotation step for CI secrets used by that pool (rotate keys used to decrypt test creds)
- update image build job to run `chroot` network namespace checks and fail if unexpected listeners present

alex: The KMS rotation step is doable. We can add a short lived key via our KMS workflow: `gcloud kms keys versions create --key=ci-temp-rot --location=us-central1` and update the decrypt job. But want to avoid breaking parallel runs. We can scope it to the failing job only.

maria: Thanks. Also attached quick repro command to check CNI version inside the image: 
```
docker run --rm -it gcr.io/redwood/ci-builder:latest /bin/bash -c "/opt/cni/bin/kube-cni-plugin --version"
```
If version < 1.4.2 it's vulnerable per the advisory.

jamie: I can push the network deny rule ASAP. One note: blocking package mirrors might make builds flaky — we should instead block all egress except to our internal apt cache and the container registry.

ryan: Approving the temporary waiver if SRE + infra implement the three mitigations (svc acct lockdown, egress deny except internal mirrors, KMS rotation) and we put an alert to auto-revoke after 7 days. Also need one more approver from infra.

alex: I'll own the KMS rotation change and the image build tweak. ETA: 6 hours.

jamie: I'll add the firewall/egress rules and the alert to revoke the waiver after 7 days. ETA: 3 hours.

maria: From security: I'll document the compensating controls and submit the risk waiver for 7 days in the RCA tracker (SEC-4521). Will include rollback criteria and test plan.

sec-bot: SEC-4521 updated: temporary risk waiver requested by maria. Approvers required: 2. Current approvals: ryan. Expires in 7 days unless revoked.

alex: question — do we want an allowlist entry for our vulnerability scanner to mark this as a confirmed true positive with a waiver note? That prevents repeated noisy alerts.

maria: Yes, add a scanner exception scoped to `gcr.io/redwood/ci-builder:*` and reference SEC-4521. Set expiration = 7 days.

ryan: :thumbsup: once the controls are in place, mark me as approver in the tracker.

jamie: Done — egress rules and alert in. I also added a k8s NetworkPolicy to drop inbound from the CI pool to sensitive namespaces.

maria: Updated SEC-4521 with mitigation evidence and linked PRs: infra#321 (kms rotation), sre#654 (egress rules), sec#987 (waiver doc). Requesting final infra approver.

alex: Approved (infra). Note: we'll land a patched builder image next week; I'll open a follow-up to remove the exception and rotate the KMS keys again.

sec-bot: SEC-4521 status: APPROVED. Waiver expires at 1805609120. Reminder scheduled 6 days before expiry.

maria: Thanks team. After expiry we'll verify image rebuild with patched `kube-cni-plugin` and then delete the scanner exception.

ryan: Thanks, good process. :white_check_mark:

jamie: Closing loop — I added a postmortem template item to track why the vulnerable package landed in the CI image.

maria: End of thread — will follow up with the post-patch verification log here when done.
